White]] *[[Heather Antos]] {{C|Assistant editor}} |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |release date=[[November 29]], [[2017]] |pages=32 |upc= |timeline=[[34 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Poe Dameron'' 21 to [[34 ABY]]. |series=''[[Star Wars: Poe Dameron]]'' |issue=21 }} '''''Poe Dameron'' 21''' is the twenty-first issue of the [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Poe Dameron]]''. The comic was written by [[Charles Soule]] with art by [[Angel Unzueta]]. It was released on [[November 29]], [[2017]]. ==Publisher's summary== ''*''Black Squadron'' is on a mission…'''' ''*''Impossible? Not for Poe Dameron's crew!'''' ''*''It's prison break time!'''' ==Opening crawl== {{OpeningCrawl |name=LEGEND FOUND
Part II |text=Insidious forces are at work across the galaxy. Officially, the First Order and the New Republic are at peace, but a cold war wages in secret between them. General Leia Organa's brave Resistance works to fend off the First Order's efforts on all fronts. Organa has placed Poe Dameron in charge of Black Squadron, an elite team of X-wing pilots. One of their ongoing missions has been tracking down Lor San Tekka, believing the explorer holds the key to finding Organa's missing brother, the Jedi Luke Skywalker. Now Black Squadron - teamed with General Organa herself - has arrived on Cato Neimoidia to retrieve the famed explorer. The only issue is that Lor San Tekka has been arrested for breaking into secure vaults and is awaiting trials for his crimes.... }} ==Plot summary== {{Plot|comic}} ==Media==
